brief: Paste the patient's message to the clinic.
name: Patient message triage
description: Sorts a message to the clinic, sends emergencies straight to 112, drafts a reply that gives no diagnosis or dose, and waits for the clinic staff every time.

steps.prompt: Is there any diagnosis, medicine, dose or medical advice (there must not be)? Does an emergency start with calling 112? Does it share no more health data than needed?
A reply to a patient. The clinic staff read it before it goes out.
